content: One description mechanism for different configuration classes Type: valid Description: There shall be only one configuration description mechanism for all different kinds of configuration classes. So regardless if "pre-compile-time" or "link-time" or "post-build-time" configuration is described the description format shall be the same. Rationale: The description of the configuration shall be independent from the BSW implementations. Additional information might be needed if the parameter class changes in the implementation, e.g. memory location for post-build-time parameters. Use Case: If one BSW module is configured to be "pre-compile-time" configuration - and this module is exchanged against a "link-time" configuration one - the ECU Configuration description shall not change due to this exchange.
